_comment: Classic MVP village -- exactly ten rooms. Hub MB00001 Millbrook Square.

rooms.title: Millbrook - Village Square
rooms.description: A worn fountain anchors the square. Villagers gossip by the well; the trailhead south leads to the wild country.

rooms.title: Millbrook - Village Gate
rooms.description: A timber palisade and a guard's bench face the road north. The square opens south.

rooms.title: Millbrook - Rusty Tankard Inn
rooms.description: Smoke and stew steam in the common room. A bard's lute case hangs above the bar.

rooms.title: Millbrook - Smithy
rooms.description: The forge hammer rings steady. Horseshoes and short swords line the wall.

rooms.title: Millbrook - Temple of the Dawn
rooms.description: Sun motifs cover the altar cloth. Clerics tend the sick in quiet alcoves.

rooms.title: Millbrook - Mage Tower
rooms.description: Scroll tubes and chalk diagrams clutter a narrow stair. The air smells of ozone.

rooms.title: Millbrook - Market Row
rooms.description: Canvas awnings shade stalls of grain, cloth, and iron pots. The inn lies west; the tower north.

rooms.title: Millbrook - Town Well
rooms.description: A stone well rope creaks in the breeze. Buckets and gossip gather here at dusk.

rooms.title: Millbrook - Barracks
rooms.description: Bunks and weapon racks for the village guard. A duty roster lists wolf sightings.

rooms.title: Millbrook - Trailhead
rooms.description: A signpost reads 'Wild Country -- mind the wolves.' The forest trail runs west; the square is north.
